jobs.title: Alliance & Delivery Manager, Pharma Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

About the Role

We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account.

Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts.

This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role. You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible.

You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust.

What You'll Do

Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams.

Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner.

Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development.

Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners.

Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs.

Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Work with Business Development on scoping, proposals and pricing, and provide a feasibility assessment before anything is committed.

Plan scientific and BD materials: schedule conference and BD material cycles as part of the delivery plan, and coordinate partner approvals for any communication based on partnered programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years in project management, alliance and/or account management, or partner delivery in biotech, pharma, a CRO or a techbio.

  • Master's degree in a scientific or engineering field. A PhD is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated delivery of complex scientific programs: you have led multidisciplinary projects from plan to final deliverable, including when results reshaped the plan.

  • Pharma-facing experience: you have managed pharma stakeholders through steering committees, negative results and scope negotiations.

  • Commercial track record: you have identified and converted follow-on opportunities within existing accounts.

  • Hands-on systems building: you have designed project management systems and automated recurring workflows.

  • Working knowledge of oncology or molecular biology, sufficient to lead scientific discussions with our teams and partners.

  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in precision oncology or at a pharma-facing CRO.

  • Familiarity with patient-derived tumor models, omics or drug screening.

  • Scripting (Python) or experience deploying automation and AI tools.

  • Experience working with SOWs and contracts.

  • Professional French.

Who You Are

  • An owner: you take responsibility for outcomes across teams you do not manage, and you make explicit trade-offs when programs compete.

  • Scientifically fluent: you understand what a result means for the partner's asset before you plan around it.

  • Steady under pressure: you replan quickly if the data changes, and you deliver difficult news to partners clearly and early.

  • A builder: you treat every recurring manual task as something to standardise or automate.

  • Commercially minded: you recognise when a partner's needs extend beyond the signed scope and turn it into a proposal.

Why Join Orakl

  • Own a portfolio of pharma partnerships. Represent Orakl from signature to final delivery, with direct access to partner decision-makers.

  • Work on distinctive science. Deliver programs built on virtual patients cohorts, functional drug screening & multi-omics.

  • Build the delivery model. Design how Orakl runs partnered programs as the portfolio scales.

  • Work across disciplines every day. Alongside the biologists, data scientists and computational biologists who generate the results.

  • Help shape the team. Define the delivery capabilities and future team needs as the partnership portfolio grows.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: align on motivation, role scope and expectations.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: discuss a pharma program you delivered: the plan, the problems, how you managed the partner and the outcome.

  3. Delivery Case: using an anonymised, representative scenario, build a plan, triage issues and prepare a steering committee. Present it to the team.

  4. Reference Call: speak with one or two people who have seen you manage partners and deliver programs.

  5. Founder Interview: discuss Orakl's partnership strategy and mutual ambitions.

The WEP Clinical Senior Project Manager (France Early Access) is responsible for leading, establishing, and managing WEP Clinical's France Early Access service offering, including both operational delivery and business development for named patient programs and expanded access programs within the French market.


This role combines deep Market Access expertise with project management discipline to ensure compliant, commercially viable, and operationally excellent early access programs in France.

  • Problem Solver

    France Market Access & Regulatory Strategy

  • Maintain current, in-depth knowledge of French regulatory frameworks governing early access, including:
  • Autorisation d'Accès Précoce (AAP) – Early Access Authorisation
  • Autorisation d'Accès Compassionnel (AAC) – Compassionate Access Authorisation
  • Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé – The French National Agency for Medicines and Health Products Safety (ANSM) requirements and submission processes
  • Haute Autorité de Santé – the French National Authority for Health (HAS) requirements and submission processes

    • Operational Delivery & Project Management

  • Lead end-to-end setup and delivery of France Early Access programs, including project planning, timeline management, budget oversight, and risk mitigation.

    • Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong, positive client relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for clients of France Early Access programs throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Data Management Clinical Operations, Business Development, Market Access and Legal) to ensure seamless program delivery.
  • Provide training and guidance to internal teams on French regulatory requirements, early access pathways, and cultural/nuanced operational considerations in France.
  • Mentor and support junior staff assigned to France Early Access programs, ensuring they understand French-specific compliance and operational standards.

    • What You'll Need:

    Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree (health, life sciences, or pharmacy preferred)
  • Significant experience in Market Access, Medical Affairs, or Early Access Programs, with specific exposure to the French pharmaceutical regulatory environment
  • Demonstrated ability to lead early access or named patient programs from feasibility through to close-out
  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken) – essential for regulatory communication and client engagement in France
  • Strong knowledge of key external stakeholder (ANSM/CEPS/URSSAF) processes and French early access legislation
  • Experience working in a CRO, pharmaceutical company, or consultancy with a focus on European early access markets
  • Computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience with eTMF and CTMS platforms
  • Strong organisational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced, client-facing environment

In this role, you will manage complex technical projects involving internal teams, external partners and customers. You will be responsible for keeping projects on track, managing expectations, identifying risks early and ensuring successful delivery within scope, time and budget.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong technical background, hands-on project management experience and exposure to offshore or subsea environments such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or related activities. You will join a growing scale-up environment where processes are still evolving, and where your experience can directly contribute to how we mature our project management approach.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope and within budget.

  • Act as the main point of contact for customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Manage projects related to offshore, subsea or marine operations, such as subsea cable installation, geotechnical monitoring, marine surveys or similar activities.

  • Coordinate closely with R&D, engineering, production, commercial and other internal teams to ensure successful project execution.

  • Translate technical requirements into clear project deliverables, timelines and actions.

  • Identify project risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect delivery, quality and customer expectations.

  • Monitor project progress, budget, planning, scope and key milestones.

  • Support bid development, technical discussions and customer relationship management where needed.

  • Contribute to improving project management processes, tools and ways of working in a scaling organization.

  • Capture lessons learned, share knowledge and support others in building strong project delivery practices.

What’s in it for you

  • Regular team activities and shared lunches throughout the week.


What we’re looking for:

  • MSc degree in Engineering, Physics, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology or another relevant technical discipline.

  • Around 5–8 years of relevant project management experience in a technical environment.

  • Experience with offshore, subsea or marine-related projects, such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or similar.

  • Strong planning, budgeting, risk management and project execution skills.

  • Experience working with multidisciplinary technical teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, partners and internal teams.

  • Technical affinity and the ability to understand complex technologies and translate them into practical project deliverables.

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic scale-up environment where priorities can shift and processes are still being developed.

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


About MoonPay Enterprise

MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

What You'll Own

KYB product strategy & roadmap

  • Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

  • Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

  • MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

  • Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

Onboarding funnel & conversion

  • The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

  • Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

  • Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

KYB API & partner experience

  • The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

  • Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

Compliance as product

  • Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

  • EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

  • Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

Vendor & provider orchestration

  • The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it.

  • Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place.

  • Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk.

  • Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone.

Who You Are

  • A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature.

  • High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it.

  • Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction.

  • AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team.

  • Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy.

  • You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification.

  • At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers.

  • You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build.

  • A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped.

  • Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for.

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry.

Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide.

Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation.

Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline.

You'll own projects end-to-end: roadmap, trade-offs, shipping, and cross-team contract. You will also:

  • Own the roadmap of the bidding pipeline. How we target, price, pace and cap, and what goes live in the bid path and when.

  • Own the delivery. Adapt to changes, set clear priorities, communicate effectively

  • Own experimentation as a product. Other teams test ideas on the bidder through the framework we build. You make sure they can run the experiments they need, trust the results, and get an answer fast.

  • Keep the pieces fitting together. You spot a change in one team that will break another before it reaches production.

  • Contribute to the product strategy beyond your scope.

Profile (Must have)

  • Experience in programmatic advertising. You have worked on pricing, bidding or auction logic on a DSP, bidder or exchange, you know the pipeline from bid request to win, and you can explain the business impact of your work.

  • Analytical mindset. You back decisions with data and understand the statistical basis of pricing and experimentation.

  • You own outcomes across teams. When a change in one team is about to break another, you catch it and drive the fix before it ships.

  • You use AI tooling daily to write specs, analyse data and prototype, and you move faster because of it.

Profile (Nice to have)

  • Mobile user acquisition: app install campaigns, attribution or mediation.

  • Experience working with ML or data science teams.

  • Supply-side experience: ad exchange or SSP.

  • Background in statistics, operations research or economics.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote Fridays

jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Product Team 👋

Trainline’s Product team sits at the heart of how millions of people across the UK and Europe plan and book their travel. As Europe’s number one rail travel app, we serve millions of active customers every week across the UK, France, Italy and Spain, and our platform is central to a seamless, end-to-end travel experience. We’re looking for a Product Manager to help drive revenue growth across one of our key revenue lines, including Partnerships and Insurance, and to help scale these areas significantly over the next three years.

You’ll play a foundational role in shaping our monetisation product strategy for the number one travel app in Europe, a business serving tens of millions of users across the UK, France, Spain and Italy. The role combines customer empathy, creative merchandising and commercial thinking to deliver significant, measurable value, and you’ll work closely with teams across the business, including Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Data Science, Design and Engineering, to bring new ideas to market and help them grow.

In this role as the Product Manager for Monetisation at Trainline, you will...🚄

  • Own the monetisation product strategy and roadmap for at least one major revenue stream, such as Partnerships or Insurance, with scope to shape new lines as they emerge.

  • Build a deep understanding of customer journeys and design merchandising experiences, across both app and web, that convert, upsell and delight.

  • Work hands-on to drive revenue: testing, launching and scaling monetisation features that deliver against ambitious growth targets.

  • Continuously evaluate product-market fit, pricing approaches, conversion rates and the underlying economics of each feature to find new ways to create value.

  • Balance quick wins with longer-term capabilities such as segmentation, targeting, pricing flexibility and personalisation.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Partnerships and Finance, as well as Data Science, Design and Engineering, to bring new business lines to market and help them scale.

  • Identify new monetisation opportunities based on customer needs, market trends and competitive insight.

  • Share monetisation best practice across the wider product team, helping to set a high standard for the discipline.

We’d love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Experience growing high-performing, revenue-generating product lines, ideally within partnerships, affiliate, insurance or other performance-based models.

  • Strong product instincts and a commercial mindset, with a good sense of what great merchandising looks like and how product can shape customer behaviour.

  • Experience working in high-growth, multi-market consumer tech environments.

  • An interest in experimentation and optimisation, with a focus on achieving measurable results.

  • Experience collaborating with data scientists, designers, engineers and commercial colleagues, balancing different perspectives while keeping sight of the goal.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach, comfortable making considered decisions and bringing new ideas to the table.

  • Experience scaling products from early stage to maturity, with an understanding of what it takes to build lasting platform capabilities.

  • It would also be helpful if you have experience with pricing strategy or segmentation models, though this isn’t essential.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
  • Lead at a senior level,  presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.
  • A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.
  • The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.
  • A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.
  • Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

Why Join Us?

  • Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.
  • Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.
  • Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

We are looking for a driven, autonomous and impactful Staff Engineer to join the Billing Squad within our StoreFront department.

The Billing squad is one of the most cross-functional and fastest growing development teams within Sonar. We enable the release of all the new products that Sonar is currently bringing to the market, both for large and small customers. The AI-native, usage-based nature of our product offering is pushing us to rethink how we develop and implement innovative pricing models. This is pushing us to our limits every day!

We are growing rapidly and constantly expanding our global contactless payment ecosystem. We are looking for a leader who is hands-on enough to dive into the code, yet visionary enough to shape our architecture, drive our engineering culture, and deliver robust, cloud-native solutions. Instead of maintaining the status quo, you will drive the technical direction of cross-functional squads, mentor talented engineers, and build the scalable technology that powers Payter’s global payment platform. 

Responsibilities 

  • Lead the technical direction of cross-functional squads, owning architectural decisions (ADRs) and defining coding standards and agile best practices.

  • Design and build high-performance microservices (Go, Java) and responsive, AI-driven web interfaces (Angular) using clean architecture principles.

  • Architect and manage secure, cloud-native infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes) and drive Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Optimize system performance across SQL/NoSQL databases and ensure platform reliability through comprehensive testing, observability, and zero-trust security.

  • Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, while partnering closely with Product Managers to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

About Payter

At Payter, we are innovators, pioneers, and leaders in the dynamic realm of unattended/self-service contactless and cashless payment technology in a wide range of markets such as Electrical Vehicle Charging, Transportation, Retail, Hospitality, Vending, Charity, Parking, and beyond. The adaptable Payter platform accommodates a diverse range of payment technologies (NFC, EMV, ApplePay, GooglePay, etc.), international banking processes, closed-loop payment and loyalty schemes, and telemetry.

Through continuous innovation and in-house development, we redefine how vendors connect with their customers, empowering them to boost revenue, enhance user experiences, and access real-time sales and performance data. We support a broad range of technologies, from Contact & Contactless EMV, Mifare, WiFi, 5G, Bluetooth, Touch Screens and more. Our state-of-the-art products have an extremely long service life, are of high quality, compliant with multiple international standards, boast great design, are user-friendly for all, multifunctional, and easy to integrate.


  • You have 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a tech lead or staff engineer capacity.

  • You possess strong, production-grade experience with Go (Golang) and Java for building distributed systems and microservices.

  • You have deep expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, with hands-on experience in Angular.

  • You have a proven track record designing and running cloud-native systems on at least one major cloud platform (GCP preferred), alongside a solid understanding of Kubernetes container orchestration.

  • You are experienced in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, applying DevOps/GitOps principles, and using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling like Terraform.

  • You have demonstrated the ability to lead technical projects end-to-end and possess excellent communication skills to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  • You have familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka, NATS), GraphQL API design and security engineering best practices (OWASP, SOC 2).

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

We’re hiring a Commercial Counsel to be a core member of Sierra’s legal team. We are looking for someone who has deep expertise in commercial contracts, but also someone who is eager to broaden their scope across IP, regulatory, and product. You will thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy tackling challenges beyond your comfort zone, and be excited to contribute across the business. In return, we’ll provide the support and opportunities you need to grow and excel as a lawyer. You’ll be part of a legal team that is highly respected within both the company and the broader legal industry—committed to excellence, collaboration, and making a meaningful impact.

  • Commercial Contracting: Structure, negotiate, and advise on all commercial contracts, including SaaS subscription agreements, technology licenses, professional services agreements, channel partner agreements, vendor agreements, and NDAs. Commercial privacy and security contracting experience (e.g., DPAs, BAAs, security agreements) is a plus.

  • Operational Excellence: Help build out our commercial function to be best-in-class. We aim to be the fastest and strongest, where the legal team is the differentiator in the contract lifecycle. You will be developing templates, playbooks, and workflows to drive efficiency and scalability.

  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of practice areas that underpin the commercial practice, including contract law, IP and privacy. You will also want to work in AI and understand the nuances of law as it relates to AI, including the evolving regulatory frameworks. You will be expected to advise broadly on all contractual issues and be comfortable doing so.

  • Teamwork: A team player first and foremost. Sierra is a unique place to work, with a strong sense of togetherness, and the legal team is no exception. You will look out for your colleagues and be accustomed to sharing and helping the team succeed.

  • Judgment: Understand risk in the context of a hyperscaling business, have sound judgment, and be strategic in your decision-making. You will not be afraid to make judgment calls, and you will be empowered to do so.

  • Approach: A strong work ethic with an eye for detail. You will strive for perfection and expect that of others.

  • Collaborate: Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Agent Development teams to support revenue growth and strategic business initiatives.

What you’ll bring

  • 2-6 years of legal experience, with a combination of both large law firm and in-house experience at a tech company.

  • A strong background in negotiating and managing complex commercial contracts, preferably in SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written) and the ability to partner with both legal and non-legal stakeholders.

  • A proactive mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

Even better…

  • Experience of privacy/regulatory frameworks and can advise on data processing agreements and security-related contract provisions.

  • Non-English languages, especially Spanish, German and French.

  • A passion for AI, with a deep understanding of AI products, LLMs and the related legal issues.

  • Law firm experience at a top-tier, internationally recognized law firm.

  • Experience working at a high-growth startup and operating with a sense of ownership.

  • Industry specific knowledge in any of the following: Financial Services, Healthcare, Telecoms, Insurance and/or Consumer.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About fal

fal is the generative media platform for developers. We give the world's most ambitious AI teams the fastest way to run image, video, audio and 3D models in production. We also provide the GPU infrastructure they need to train, fine-tune and serve models of their own.

Our inference engine was built from the ground up for generative media. It has made fal the platform builders reach for when speed, scale and reliability matter. Our customers range from the fastest-growing AI companies in the world to the Fortune 500. More and more of them are coming to us for raw compute as well as inference and model APIs.

We're a small, high-output team, and we're growing fast. If you want to be in the room while the infrastructure layer of generative AI gets built, this is that room.

About the Role

As an Account Executive on our Compute team, you'll own new-logo acquisition across AI-native startups and neolabs. You'll sell fal's full compute offering: dedicated GPU clusters, reserved and on-demand capacity, and the inference platform that developers already build on. This is a pure hunter role. You won't inherit a book. You'll build one, and with it you'll help define how fal takes compute to market.

What You'll Do

Build and own your pipeline

  • Own all net-new logo acquisition across a defined set of AI-native startups, neolabs and research-driven model builders.

  • Work with our capacity, finance and deal desk teams to secure supply and structure deals that work for both the customer and fal.

  • Run the full cycle from first conversation through negotiation and signature, keeping momentum through commercial, technical and legal review.

Grow with your customers

  • Land with an initial workload, then expand as customers scale from experimentation to large training runs to production inference.

You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

  • You build relationships across an organisation, from hands-on specialists to senior decision-makers, and you're willing to challenge a client when their plan won't get them where they say they want to go.

  • You've carried a commercial target, and you know how to plan towards it rather than hope for it.

  • You understand online marketing well enough to hold a credible conversation with a performance marketing lead.

  • Not a must, but a strong plus: experience on the client side, at a marketing agency or in an in-house digital marketing team (preferably e-commerce)

  • You are willing to come to our Utrecht office for 2 days/week, preferably more.

  • You are available to travel and visit clients.

  • You are available for at least 32 hours per week (4 days).

  • You have a valid work permit for the Netherlands or EU citizenship.

  • Not a must, but a strong plus: experience on the client side, at a marketing agency or in an in-house digital marketing team (preferably e-commerce)

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Give our Culture Playbook a read.

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

What do we offer?

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

The role

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will lead a high-performing, interdisciplinary team of three and own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market. Your primary objective is to co-define the growth strategy and partner closely with engineering and data teams to build the systems, onboarding journeys, and experiments that bring that strategy to life.

The scope of this role is broad and we're not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning strategy, analytics, product development, and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

You'll define hypotheses, lead cross-functional initiatives, and own the roadmap for how iwoca engages with German businesses. You will be accountable for measurable impact on acquisition and conversion, bringing ideas to life through rigorous commercial insight, strong customer empathy, and practical delivery. As a Lead, you will also be responsible for coaching your team and establishing the operating rhythm for this new unit.

Experimentation and insight

  • Design, run, and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, onboarding tools, and product flows.
  • Identify opportunities using first-principle reasoning supported by data, customer research, and funnel analysis.

Cross-functional collaboration

The requirements

Essential:

  • Proven people management or team leadership experience, with the ability to build culture and establish operating rhythms in a newly formed team.

  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.
  • Experience working with (or a strong desire to learn about) technical models such as lead scoring, predictive targeting, or qualification logic.

Bonus:

  • Experience working closely with engineering, product, or data science teams to ship features or models.
  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

Work in the EU

Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

jobs.title: Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Beratung

Als Project Manager übernimmst Du die Leitung von Projekten oder komplexen Teilprojekten. Deine fachliche und methodische Expertise nutzt Du zur Bearbeitung komplexer Fragestellungen und agierst als „Thought-Leader“. Neben Projekten wirkst Du an der Entwicklung unserer Services und Kompetenzen mit.

Projektmanagement

Als Experte überblickst und managst Du Projekte ganzheitlich. Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen die Planung sowie die Durchführung und Steuerung. Du übernimmst zudem die Kommunikation und Vertretung des Projektes auf Leitungsebene und nach außen.

Führungsverantwortung

Intern und auf Projekten führst Du Kollegen und Mitarbeiter. Deine Erfahrung gibst Du in Form von Coachings und Workshops weiter. Zudem teilst Du Deine Expertise in Form von Veröffentlichungen, die in Fachmedien veröffentlicht werden.

Abwechslung

Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Problemstellungen zu strukturieren, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln und zu deren zielgerichteter Umsetzung beizutragen. Du steuerst dabei Projektvorhaben von der Initiierung bis zur erfolgreichen Verankerung in der Organisation.

Was wir uns vor Du wünschen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Recht oder eine Ausbildung im Finanzbereich

  • Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche und im Management von Projekten

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von (Teil-)Projekten und Projektteams

  • Qualifikation/Zertifizierung im Projektmanagement (z. B. Scrum, IPMA, PMI)

  • Nachgewiesene Expertise in mindestens einem Schwerpunktbereich (Regulatorik, Risikomanagement, Wertpapiergeschäft, IT-Management)

  • Hohe Problemlösungskompetenz und Begeisterungsfähigkeit

  • Motivation sich ständig weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Versierter Umgang mit MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Teamplayer-Mentalität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1)

  • Reisebereitschaft

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität: Montags und dienstags kannst Du bequem von zu Hause arbeiten, wobei Dir unser Büro dennoch jederzeit offensteht. In dringenden Fällen ist Home-Office auch an anderen Tagen möglich. Wir legen großen Wert auf persönliche Interaktionen und passen uns flexibel den Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden an.

Weiterbildung: Du hast die Freiheit, passende Trainings, Seminare und Weiterbildungen nach Deinen Präferenzen auszuwählen. Zusätzlich bieten wir interne, mitarbeitergeführte Fortbildungen und Workshops an.

Onboarding: Ab Tag 1 statten wir Dich mit einem Laptop, einem modernem Smartphone, das Du auch privat nutzen kannst, und einer Kreditkarte für Deine beruflichen Nebenkosten aus.

Coaching: Für Deine Weiterentwicklung steht Dir ein Counsellor zur Seite, mit dem Du deine persönlichen Ziele formulierst und der Dich bei der eigenen Karriereentwicklung mit seinen Erfahrungen bestmöglich unterstützt.

Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen. Deshalb heißt es bei uns jeden Donnerstag: Massagetag! Ein geschulter Masseur und Osteopath kommt einmal in der Woche zu uns ins Büro. Darüber hinaus sind unsere Büros mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet.

Firmenevents: Freue Dich auf aufregende Teamevents und regelmäßige Get-Togethers. Von gemeinsamen Kochabenden über Formeltrainings bis hin zu Jubiläumsreisen nach London oder Malta. Diese Erlebnisse fördern den Teamgeist, schaffen gemeinsame Erfahrungen und bieten großartige Gelegenheiten, sich besser kennenzulernen.

Vergütung: Bei uns erwartet Dich ein attraktives Gehaltspaket aus festem Grundgehalt und jährlicher Bonuszahlung. Ab 5 Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit gibt's sogar noch einen extra Bonus obendrauf!

Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, um sich zu erholen und neue Energie zu tanken.

Social Responsibility: Soziales Engagement gehört für uns untrennbar zur unternehmerischen Verantwortung. Dabei stellen wir jedem Mitarbeiter ein Spendenbudget von 200€ pro Jahr zur Verfügung. Besonders am Herzen liegen uns regionale Initiativen.

Corporate Benefits: Du erhältst vergünstigte Mitarbeiterangebote auf z.B. Reisen, Mode, Technik und Veranstaltungen.

Spaß und Nervennahrung: Bei uns werden herausfordernde Arbeitstage durch packende Tischkicker-Turniere, Gespräche in der Küche und eine gesunde Dosis Vitamine aufgepeppt.

Kontakt

Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder Deiner Bewerbung?

oder melde Dich bei unserer Personalmanagerin Stephanie unter +49 69 / 950900-17
