jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

  • Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

  • Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

  • Are fluent in both French and English

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

  • Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

  • Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

  • Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

  • Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

  • Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken.

Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie.

Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie.

MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten.

Verantwoordelijkheden

Project Control

  • Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts.

  • Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren.

  • Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow.

  • Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting.

  • Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen.

  • Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie.

  • Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering.

Financial Control

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen.

  • Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces.

  • Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting.

  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie.

  • Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages.

Business Control & Business Partnering

  • Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning.

  • Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses.

  • Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie.

  • Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning.

  • Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's.

  • Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming.


Wie zoeken wij?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar.

  • Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen.

  • Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants.

  • Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing.

  • Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools.

  • Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré.

  • Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht.

  • In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders.

  • Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering.



Wat bieden wij?

Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie.

Wij bieden je:

  • Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief.

  • Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld.

  • Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • Een marktconform salaris conform de cao Architectenbureaus, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • 30 vakantiedagen, hybride werken en een inspirerende werkplek in Rotterdam.

  • Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
About DataSnipper

Audit is the bedrock of the global economy. DataSnipper builds the AI that auditors and finance teams rely on to do that work with confidence: agents designed around how audits are actually performed, a platform firms trust with their most sensitive client evidence, and a team built around former auditors who know the work firsthand. We want to define how the profession works in the age of AI.

More than 600,000 professionals across 175 countries use DataSnipper, including all Big Four firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. In 2025 alone, we delivered over $1.4 billion in productivity savings for our customers. Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners, we are one of the fastest-growing companies in AI for audit, and the fastest-growing tech company in the Netherlands two years running.

Everything we build starts from one principle: AI in audit has to be something professionals can trust, verify, and defend. Joining now means helping lead the profession's shift from manual testing to agentic execution.


The Role


Partnerships are one of DataSnipper's most important growth levers. Across every major market, the consulting firms, technology platforms, and professional networks that organizations rely on shape which technologies their teams and clients adopt. As AI changes how audit work gets done, those partners are deciding who to build with.

As Strategic Partnerships Lead, you will lead, build, and launch DataSnipper's partnerships across Europe and the wider EMEA region, spanning our consulting alliances, key technology partners, and strategic relationships across the audit ecosystem and beyond. Our European ecosystem already includes relationships with leading consulting firms and regional networks. Your job is to scale it, and to build what comes next: new partner programs, new markets, and new commercial models.

This is an entrepreneurial, quota-carrying role with a broad remit and room to build. You will report to the Global Partnerships Leader and work closely with our EMEA Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams.


What You Will Work On

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic partners across Europe, including consulting firms, technology platforms, and regional networks, and act as their senior counterpart at DataSnipper.

  • Scale existing partnerships into multi-country programs, and launch new ones market by market, adapting to local regulatory, commercial, and cultural nuances.

  • Source, assess, and close new partnerships, from referral and co-sell arrangements to resell models, prioritized against DataSnipper's growth goals.

  • Work with consulting partners to help them advise their clients on bringing AI into audit and finance, with DataSnipper at the center of that work.

  • Build joint go-to-market plans with each partner, covering account mapping, co-selling, events, and executive engagement, that turn relationships into pipeline and closed revenue.

  • Deepen key technology partnerships across the region to unlock co-sell, marketplace, and joint solution opportunities.

  • Create the enablement, playbooks, and co-marketing assets partners need to position and deliver DataSnipper with confidence.

  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue targets, and report on performance with clear, honest data.

  • Bring partner feedback from across Europe back into DataSnipper, so what you hear in the field shapes product, packaging, and pricing.

  • Be a visible face of DataSnipper across the region, at partner summits, field events, and industry forums.

  • Willingness to embrace global business and travel.

What You Bring

  • 5 to 7 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or a senior commercial role, ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or financial technology.

  • A proven track record of independently managing and growing complex, multi-stakeholder partnerships from identification through to revenue impact.

  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to negotiate partnership structures, co-sell agreements, and commercial terms with senior counterparts.

  • Experience building joint go-to-market programs and driving pipeline through partner channels across more than one European market.

  • Excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, with the credibility to work as a peer with firm leadership, from alliance leads to managing directors and partners.

  • Existing relationships with consulting firm leadership in Europe are a strong advantage.

How You Work

  • Entrepreneurial. When you spot a gap, you build what fills it, playbook or not.

  • High standards. You hold yourself, and the partners you work with, to a high bar.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Planner | DSL-01

Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project.

 

Over de functie

Als Supply Chain Planner krijg je de kans om vanaf de basis mee te bouwen aan de supply chain van DSL-01. Jouw werk helpt de basis te leggen voor een betrouwbare operatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige productiefaciliteiten voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).

Je stapt op een uniek moment in een groeiende organisatie.

Voor de start van de fabriek:

  • Help je mee de supply chain-organisatie van DSL-01 op te bouwen, inclusief de processen, systemen en werkwijzen die nodig zijn voor operational readiness.

  • Draag je bij aan de inrichting van ERP-systemen, supply chain-processen en de voorbereiding van een veilige, betrouwbare en efficiënte operatie.

Na de start van de fabriek:

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in de dagelijkse supply chain-operatie, van grondstoffen- en productieplanning tot afstemming met leveranciers en afnemers.

  • Zorg je samen met interne en externe stakeholders voor een stabiele supply chain die een veilige en continue productie ondersteunt.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van productie-, supply- en offtakeplanningen voor de korte, middellange en lange termijn.

  • Vertalen van productiebehoeften naar materiaalvereisten en afstemmen van beschikbaarheid met leveranciers, Procurement en sourcing-teams.

  • Coördineren van planning tussen Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Procurement en commerciële stakeholders.

  • Signaleren van risico's, verstoringen en capaciteitsbeperkingen en ontwikkelen van passende scenario's en oplossingen.

  • Leveren van analyses en inzichten ter ondersteuning van het Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)-proces.

  • Actief bijdragen aan de inrichting, validatie en optimalisatie van ERP-systemen en supply chain-processen.

  • Ondersteunen van processen rondom traceability, certificering en mass balancing.

  • Initiëren en leiden van verbeteringen op het gebied van planning, systemen en werkwijzen.

  • Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor complexe planningsvraagstukken tijdens operational readiness en de opstart van de fabriek.

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van operationele verantwoordelijkheid en de kans om een nieuwe supply chain-organisatie mee vorm te geven.

 

Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk, neemt eigenaarschap en voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Je bent in staat verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer informatie beperkt of onvolledig is.

Wat breng je mee?

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Supply Planner, Production Planner, Material Planner of in een vergelijkbare rol binnen een productieomgeving.

  • Een sterk begrip van supply chain-processen en ERP-systemen.

  • Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om inzichten te vertalen naar acties en besluitvorming.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte houding en een sterk gevoel van eigenaarschap.

  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe operationele omgeving.

  • Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen onder onzekerheid.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Additionele vaardigheden/ervaring

  • Ervaring binnen de proces- en maakindustrie.

  • Ervaring met ERP-implementaties, systeeminrichting of user acceptance testing.

  • Ervaring met het opstarten van nieuwe productielocaties of operationele organisaties.

  • Kennis van traceability, certificering, mass balancing, dangerous goods of waste management.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

 

Wat wij bieden

DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat geldt niet alleen voor de fabriek, maar ook voor de organisatie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ons HR-team werkt aan een passend en marktconform pakket voor de locatie in Delfzijl.

Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, een bonusregeling en arbeidsvoorwaarden die ruimte bieden voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meebouwen aan een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com & www.DSL-01.com

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG / DSL-01 is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

  • Vergunningen & wettelijke naleving: Ondersteunen bij milieuvergunningen, vergunningswijzigingen, compliance-monitoring en het beheer van wettelijke registers, waaronder REACH-gerelateerde verplichtingen.

  • Risicomanagement & assurance: Ondersteunen bij proces- en veiligheidsrisicoanalyses, zoals HAZID-, HAZOP- en RI&E-trajecten, het beheren van risicoregisters en het ondersteunen van audits, inspecties en incidentonderzoeken om risico's binnen een industriële procesomgeving te beheersen.

  • Documentatie, training & operationele gereedheid: Opstellen, beheren en onderhouden van procedures, werkinstructies, trainingsvereisten en overige QHSES-documentatie om de organisatie voor te bereiden op veilige en conforme bedrijfsvoering.

  • Stakeholder- & projectondersteuning: Fungeren als verbindende schakel tussen de corporate QHSES-organisatie en het DSL-01-projectteam en bijdragen aan certificeringstrajecten, occupational health-programma's en de succesvolle implementatie van QHSES-initiatieven.

Jouw profiel

We zijn een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je beschikt over een MBO+/HBO-opleiding in Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Techniek, Integrale Veiligheidskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Health, Safety, Environment of QHSES-gerelateerde functies.

  • Je hebt ervaring in een industriële, chemische, productie-, energie- of andere hoog-risico omgeving.

  • Je hebt een goed begrip van arbeidsveiligheidswetgeving, risicomanagement en compliance vereisten.

  • Je hebt ervaring met ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 en/of Seveso/BRZO-gerelateerde kaders.

  • Je bent bekend met risicogestuurd werken en continu verbeteren.

  • Je hebt ervaring met RI&E-processen en risicoregisters.

  • Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en werkt nauwkeurig met documentatie en systemen.

Bonus

  • Certificeringen zoals NEBOSH, HVK, MVK of vergelijkbaar.

  • Ervaring met chemische veiligheidsvraagstukken en REACH-verplichtingen.

  • Ervaring met ISO-certificeringstrajecten en externe audits.

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Wat wij bieden

DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat geldt niet alleen voor de fabriek, maar ook voor de organisatie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ons HR-team werkt aan een passend en marktconform pakket voor de locatie in Delfzijl.

Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, een bonusregeling en arbeidsvoorwaarden die ruimte bieden voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Solliciteer

Wil jij meebouwen aan een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control.   • Specification and standards management: Implement relevant standards for intelligent building management solutions, process automation, and safety systems, such as IEC 61511 (functional safety) and ATEX regulations.

  • Process optimization: Analyze and optimize industrial processes and systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

  • Stakeholder management: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders, including clients, end-users, engineers, and project managers, ensuring solutions meet both functional and technical requirements.

  • Continuous learning and development: Stay updated on the latest innovations in smart technologies and automation, applying these to develop improved, future-proof solutions. • Technological consulting: Identify innovations to enhance performance and reliability in intelligent buildings and industrial environments.

  • Documentation and communication: Prepare technical documentation and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.

Required Skills and Competencies:

  • Extensive knowledge of intelligent building management solutions, gas safety systems, and industrial process control.

  • Expertise in communication standards and protocols such as KNX, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and PROFIBUS.

  • Proficiency in designing fail-safe systems and safety-critical applications.

  • Experience with IT networks and cybersecurity in automation environments.

  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.

  • Flexibility and the ability to continuously adapt to technological advancements.

  • Excellent communication skills to clearly present complex technical issues

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field.

We offer

  • Hybrid working, where you have the opportunity to alternate between working from home and the office.

Many of our offices are located near public transport hubs, cycling is encouraged, and your travel expenses are reimbursed 100% on the basis of public transport.

As an independent engineering firm, Deerns specializes in consultancy, design and implementation supervision in the fields of installation engineering, building physics, energy supply and sustainability. The Account Manager (AM) is a key client partner and collaborative leader within Infinite Lambda. Responsible for owning and growing accounts, AMs play a crucial role in ensuring successful delivery, maintaining client satisfaction, and driving commercial outcomes. While AMs are expected to operate independently, they collaborate closely with delivery teams and seek support from Senior Account Managers when needed.

This role belongs to the Account Management Department, part of the broader Customer Success Division. AMs work cross-functionally with Engineering Excellence and Delivery Excellence teams, ensuring alignment between client goals and internal execution.

This role does not include direct reports but requires strong leadership through influence. You will collaborate with engineers, architects, analysts, project managers, and commercial teams to deliver measurable client outcomes and drive revenue growth.

Key Objectives

  • Drive sustainable, forecastable growth: Secure new business opportunities from assigned accounts, retain clients, and ensure their satisfaction through exceptional delivery.

  • Build enduring partnerships: Establish yourself as a trusted partner to clients, ensuring long-term collaboration and profitability.

You lead by example and foster a culture based on trust, empowerment, and excellence with your accounts and the teams you work with.

 

Detailed Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Develop and nurture strong relationships with assigned clients, serving as the main point of contact and advocate for their needs;

  • Understand each client’s business objectives, challenges, and strategic goals to deliver tailored solutions that align with their vision;

  • Proactively establish Infinite Lambda as a trusted partner, consistently delivering tangible value and maintain client engagement ;

  • Facilitate regular check-ins, quarterly business reviews, and strategic planning sessions to ensure alignment and promote long-term partnerships.

  • Act as a cultural ambassador, fostering trust-based relationships that reflect Infinite Lambda’s values and create a positive, lasting experience for both clients and colleagues;

  • Champion sustainable growth by aligning client success with long-term partnership and responsible use of data and AI technology.

Revenue Growth & Account Development

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within client environments;

  • Drive renewals and contract discussions, with support from commercial leadership as needed;

  • Drive financial performance by meeting revenue targets, securing competitive pricing, and maintaining consistent growth in gross margins and profitability;

  • Proactively manage opportunity pipelines, converting opportunities into measurable revenue.

Strategic Account Planning

  • Define and implement account strategies in line with the direction provided by the Chief Customer Success Officer (CCO);

  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and delivery teams to develop comprehensive account strategies that leverage Infinite Lambda’s offerings and expertise;

  • Analyse client industries, competitors, and market trends to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks;

  • Contribute insights to product and service development based on client feedback and market needs.

 

Sales Handover & Onboarding

  • Take ownership of new accounts after contract signature;

  • Lead smooth client onboarding processes in coordination with delivery and sales.

 

Collaboration & Internal Alignment

  • Coordinate with project teams to ensure alignment on client deliverables, project timelines, and resource allocation;

  • Work closely with project teams to identify opportunities for innovation or new initiatives within accounts;

  • Act as the primary escalation point for client-related issues, ensuring swift and effective resolution while preserving relationships;

  • Provide regular updates and insights to internal stakeholders, ensuring company-wide visibility on account health and performance.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain high standards across account efficiency, revenue performance, and client experience;

  • Track KPIs: revenue growth, NPS, forecast accuracy, GSS/FSS;

  • Produce at least two domain-relevant artefacts per year (e.g. case studies, blogs, market insights).

 

Compensation and Performance Targets

The compensation for the Account Manager role is composed of a base salary and a variable component tied directly to performance. The variable portion is determined by success in three key performance indicators (KPIs):

  • Financial Accuracy & Stability: Ensuring accounts are managed with precision, budgets are adhered to, and financial processes are stable and reliable;

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Driving client satisfaction and advocacy, as measured by their likelihood to recommend our services;

  • Account Revenue Growth and Sustain: Strategically fostering account growth through innovative solutions and long-term revenue stability.

This structure aligns rewards with results, ensuring performance excellence is recognised and incentivised.

 

Measurement Metrics

The success of the Account Manager role is evaluated based on the following categories:

 

Client Satisfaction

  • Client Feedback (NPS): Track satisfaction trends quarterly, ensuring consistent improvement from the baseline;

  • Referrals & Testimonials: Secure at least one public recommendation or referral per client.

Revenue Growth

  • Upselling/Cross-selling Revenue

  • Revenue Target Achievement

  • Gross Margin

  • Growth and Sustain Score (GSS)

  • Financial Stability Score (FSS)

Activity & Productivity

  • Client Interactions: Maintain consistent touchpoints through regular meetings and planning sessions.

  • Forecast Accuracy: Minimise the variance between initial forecasts and actual revenue.

 

Qualifications and Skills

  • Proven extensive experience in account management, client relationship development, and revenue growth;

  • Strong ability to build inclusive, trusted relationships with business and operational stakeholders, grow toward engaging executive leadership, and create positive experiences;

  • Strong consultative skills, with the ability to identify and address client needs proactively;

  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a results-driven mindset;

  • Outstanding communication, negotiation, and presentation skills;

  • Proficiency in analysing financial metrics and delivering data-driven insights;

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multi-year accounts in a dynamic environment;

  • High level of autonomy and capability to work with minimal oversight while delivering measurable results;

  • Exceptional collaboration and alignment skills, ensuring seamless interaction between clients and internal teams;

  • Commitment to supporting sustainable growth.

Examples of said proof include extract n°3 of the Criminal Record (France), Büntetlen előélet (Hungary), Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check (UK), an extract from the Criminal Register (Slovakia), or a country-specific equivalent. Providing proof of a clean criminal record is the final step in the hiring process and will only be requested should the applicant accept an offer from Infinite Lambda.

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.

Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.

Core Responsibilities
  • As a Product Design intern, your responsibilities look similar to a full-time designer, with the resources, stability, and mentorship of an established tech company. You’ll work on product teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of real product features. You will work with fellow Designers, Product Managers, Developers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to refine and evolve the quality of Palantir products.
  • Interaction and visual design. You'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience designing and prototyping using tools such as Figma.
  • User research. We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. You'll often visit customer offices to interview and learn from the users we serve. You'll pair qualitative methods (e.g. scripted usability tests and contextual inquiry) with quantitative information, like product and usage metrics.
  • Deliver and communicate designs in close collaboration. We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers and product managers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.
  • Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies.

    • What We Value
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build great relationships with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders, and convey and debate design rationale.
  • High empathy and dedication to the user, striving to understand and empower them.
  • An iterative design process. You validate your ideas early (with stakeholders and users) and are thoughtful and intentional in seeking and responding to feedback. You move fast, listen, and adapt. You rapidly incorporate feedback, and prioritize collaboration. You are adept at giving and receiving critiques.
  • Excitement for solving hard, complex problems. You are excited to design for technically complex and data dense interfaces. You thrive in an environment where you can jump into deep subject matter expertise to define simple, approachable, yet still powerful product experiences.
  • Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed.

    • What We Require
  • Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least one software interface design project. If parts of your portfolio are password-protected, please include your portfolio password under 'Additional Questions' when applying.
    • Life at Palantir
     
    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
     
    In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
     
    If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help.
     
    Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Product/Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.


Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

  • Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling Sales, Customer Success and Marketing with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Commercial, you make sure every seat in Sales, Customer Success and Marketing goes to someone exceptional. You report to Fritz Cramer, Co-CEO, and work closely with our VP Sales, Head of SC Sales, Head of Customer Success and Marketing Lead. That means real ownership: you shape how Cosuno hires, not just who.

What you will achieve in your first 12 months

  • You hire 25 people across Account Executives, Customer Success and Inside Sales Managers, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • You turn every role into a clear scorecard and give hiring managers structured interviews they actually use.

  • You relaunch our referral programme and turn our team into our best talent scouts.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.


What the job really looks like

  • A large part of your week is active sourcing and candidate conversations. If you prefer managing agencies, this role is not for you.

  • You run several commercial processes in parallel, with ambitious hiring managers who want great people fast.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile or a decision is not right. We want you to.


What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, hiring SDRs and Account Executives.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Proven sourcing skills: you have filled roles through direct outreach and can show what worked.

  • Structured assessment: you run scorecard-based interviews and can tell real sales talent from a good pitch.

  • Strong closing skills: you win top candidates against competing offers and counteroffers.

  • Strong stakeholder management: you advise hiring managers and challenge them when it matters.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • You use AI tools and automation in sourcing and outreach.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.


What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay and Lusha, and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25-30 vacation days per year.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.


Our hiring process (max. 3 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Career deep-dive with Fritz (Co-CEO) 30 minutes, video.

  3. Live case study: together with two of our hiring managers (Basti, Kornelius or Caspar), you work through a sourcing case for a fictional SDR role, 60 minutes, preferably in our Berlin office.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 2–3 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 3 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Analyst, User Acquisition
jobs.description:
Who we are

JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business, from the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events and best-selling console games. We also own the world's largest streaming guide, giving us unique insights into audience behaviours and content tastes.

From a small startup, we've evolved into a team of more than 200 people, based in Berlin, around the world or working remotely. We've built a profitable business while continuing to grow.

Who we need

We are looking for a Senior Growth Analyst with at least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics. You will support growth across JustWatch TV and our streaming guide, with the main focus on JustWatch TV.

You will partner with our marketing, campaign, product and Business Intelligence teams to understand which acquisition activity brings valuable users, improve confidence in measurement and testing, and turn findings into budget and campaign decisions.




What you will be doing
  • Analyse user acquisition performance across channels, markets and audiences, and recommend where to scale, adjust or stop spending.

  • Develop our attribution approach and interpret MMP and ad platform reporting. Work with BI and technical teams to define conversion events, validate tracking and resolve data discrepancies. You will lead analytical requirements and validation; technical teams own implementation.

  • Analyse acquisition cohorts, activation, retention, subscription conversion and revenue alongside LTV, CAC, ROAS and payback periods. Make assumptions explicit and use findings to guide acquisition and bidding targets.

  • Design and evaluate A/B tests, holdouts and incrementality tests with the marketing team. Distinguish attributed conversions from incremental impact and turn findings into practical recommendations.

  • Build benchmarks, forecasts, dashboards and efficient reporting to guide planning, budgets and growth targets, working with BI to keep KPI definitions consistent and data reliable.

  • Support selected client campaign analyses and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, prioritising work that improves decisions and performance.


    • What we need from you

  • Essential experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in user acquisition or performance marketing analytics, ideally in an app, subscription or digital consumer business.

  • A strong understanding of mobile analytics, including attribution, conversion events, measurement limitations and discrepancies between data sources.

  • An understanding of paid acquisition channels such as Meta, TikTok and Google, their optimisation goals and performance metrics.

  • Experience analysing acquisition funnels, retention cohorts and unit economics to assess user value beyond installs or initial conversions.

  • Confident working with spreadsheets, BI tools and data from multiple sources.

  • The ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations, challenge assumptions constructively and prioritise independently.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

    • Useful extras

  • Hands-on experience with mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Adjust.

  • Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, holdouts or incrementality tests.

  • SQL or Python.

  • Experience with CTV app measurement, ASO or CRM and lifecycle analytics.

  • German language skills.


    • What we offer you

  • An open-minded, international team that enjoys collaborating to reach shared goals.

  • Meaningful work, opportunities for personal growth and the chance to make a lasting impact.

  • A permission-less environment where you can take ownership and focus on delivering value without unnecessary complexity.

  • Trust in your expertise and judgement, with room to improve how we work and bring new ideas.

  • A collaborative and supportive environment that helps you achieve your personal and professional goals.

  • A flexible hybrid working environment, with no requirement to come to the office.

    • Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality. 
     
    If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:
    • A company culture that really works
    • Audience as a Service
    • Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog

    How to apply

    Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

    Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

    If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model.

The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track.

You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns.

You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches.

Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration.

Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes.

Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over

New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases.

Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability.

Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands.

🙌 You should apply if:

You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field.

You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers.

You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability.

You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer.

You care about operational reliability and release quality.

Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews: leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total

  • Deep-dive interviews: domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total

  • Final interview: values alignment (30-45 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are currently seeking an exceptional Senior Strategic Finance Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team. You can be based in either our Barcelona or London office.

The Strategic Finance department is responsible for crafting our long-term strategic roadmap and optimizing how we allocate resources to fuel our growth and create lasting value. Reporting to the Senior Director of Strategic Finance, you will be pivotal in shaping the company's operational plan and creating scalable business models. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll be instrumental in translating intricate operational goals into financial outcomes. Your keen analytical skills and effective communication abilities will be put to good use as you cultivate strong relationships throughout the organization. We aim to build a top-tier strategic finance team that prioritizes unwavering accountability. If you're ready to embark on this journey with us, read on!

 

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of both short-term and long-term forecasting models, ensuring the leadership team has the data for precise decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with key cross-functional teams, in particular the go-to-market team, to gain insights into critical business developments that could impact future projections.

  • Support for the comprehensive planning and execution of both the long-term strategic plan and the annual operating plan.

  • Utilize an analytical approach to influence strategic decision-making, encompassing capital allocation and long-term financial planning choices.

  • Execute essential financial processes, including reporting, forecasting, budgeting, ROI-based resource allocation, and internal as well as external benchmarking.

  • Monitor crucial performance metrics and offer valuable insights through regular reporting and ad hoc analysis.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience in investment banking, management consulting, or strategic finance/FP&A. Expertise or coverage of go-to-market functions within any of these roles is a bonus but not a must.

  • A track record of exceptional performance in demanding, high-calibre teams.

  • Data-driven mindset, a bias for rapid decision-making, favouring excellence over perfection.

  • Proficiency in Excel, including the ability to create and manage complex financial models.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in analytical work - accelerating analysis, stress-testing assumptions, automating repetitive processes - and the judgment to know when human input is still essential.

  • Strong knowledge of financial statements, accounting principles, and investment analysis.

  • Capability to comprehend and collaborate with various lines of business.

  • Willingness to stretch beyond your comfort zone and embrace new challenges.

  • Openness to feedback, with a commitment to continuous improvement, development, and innovation.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a quantitative field.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
