Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably. With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 30,000 online shops, and over 50 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world.

To strengthen our Engineering Department, we are looking for a

Cloud Engineer (f/m/d)

Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time)

Join our Legal Tech Services Team, part of the Business Domain, where we build products that help online businesses stay legally compliant and protected. Our solutions provide legal texts, compliance services, and expert support that enable thousands of online shops to operate with confidence.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and operating secure and scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS. Working closely with software engineers, a Product Manager, and an Agile Coach, you will help shape our cloud platform, enable development teams through automation and Infrastructure as Code, and contribute to a reliable, observable, and cost-efficient cloud environment.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure on AWS.

  • Contribute to the introduction, deployment, and operation of new services and infrastructure capabilities across their lifecycle.

  • Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure-as-Code components with Terraform and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling, primarily based on CircleCI.

  • Help establish and evolve standards for monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability to ensure reliable and efficient operations.

  • Support cloud governance, AWS resource lifecycle management, cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and cloud security best practices.

  • Apply AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices to improve automation, delivery speed, and operational efficiency.

  • Participate in incident response and on-call rotations, while collaborating with internal teams and external hosting providers to ensure reliable operations and maintain supporting infrastructure.


  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and operating cloud infrastructure on AWS - such as ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, SQS, etc.- along with strong expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code, ideally with Terraform

  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automation solutions, ideally with CircleCI.

  • Solid scripting or software development skills in Bash, TypeScript or Python.

  • Practical experience using AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools in DevOps workflows, combined with the curiosity and ability to evaluate emerging AI capabilities.

  • Experience with containerized environments using Docker and Amazon ECS.

  • Strong understanding of monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability concepts (e.g. CloudWatch, Instana), including troubleshooting across applications and infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices, AWS governance, FinOps, and experience working with externally hosted environments, complemented by practical experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools.

What we offer you

  • Hybrid work: Combine flexible remote work with team time in the Cologne office (on-site days depending on your location)

  • Workation: Temporarily work from a destination of your choice within EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway

  • 28 vacation days

  • 2.5 additional days off at Christmas, New Year's Eve and Carnival

  • Buddy program (an experienced trustee is at your side)

  • Events (Team Events, Unit Events, etc.)

jobs.title: Customer Journey Manager Automotive (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Bovensiepen Group

Was 1965 in Kaufbeuren als Vision von Burkard Bovensiepen begann, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit unverwechselbarer DNA. Seit Jahren wird das Familienunternehmen von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian geführt und steht für automobile Meisterwerke, handwerkliche Exzellenz und Perfektion in jedem Detail. Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und höchstem Qualitätsanspruch.

Mit dem Übergang der ALPINA Markenrechte an BMW beginnt jetzt für die Gruppe ein neues Kapitel. Die automobile Leidenschaft wird unter der eigenständigen Marke Bovensiepen mit neuer Ausrichtung weitergeführt. Sechs Sparten bilden dabei das Rückgrat der Unternehmensgruppe, die Transformation als Chance versteht.

Für den Ausbau unseres Gebrauchtwagengeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und handelnde Führungspersönlichkeit.

Ihre Rolle – Kundenerlebnis, Auftrag und Weiterentwicklung in einer Hand

Sie verantworten das Kundenerlebnis für zwei Fahrzeugwelten: unsere Bovensiepen-Neufahrzeuge, die in unserer Manufaktur in Buchloe nach Kundenwunsch entstehen, und unsere Certified Cars, geprüfte und aufbereitete Premium-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge.

Ab der ersten Anfrage begleiten Sie den Kunden Hand in Hand mit unseren Verkaufsberatern und Handelspartnern: Der Vertrieb führt das Verkaufsgespräch, Sie machen den gesamten Weg bis zur Übergabe und die Zeit danach zu einem Erlebnis. Ihre Kunden erwarten, dass jedes Detail sitzt und schätzen jede Idee, die ihr Fahrzeug noch persönlicher macht.

Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns in dieser Form zum ersten Mal. Sie übernehmen keinen fertigen Prozess, Sie gestalten ihn: Welche Momente begeistern unsere Kunden? Wie sieht eine Übergabe aus, von der sie noch Jahre später erzählen? Wann ist der richtige Zeitpunkt für die passende Sonderausstattung? Ihre Antworten setzen Sie selbst um. 50 Meter neben Ihrem Schreibtisch entstehen die Fahrzeuge, die Sie betreuen.

Aufgaben

  • Konfiguration und Individualisierung: Sie beraten Kunden gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu Ausstattung, Materialien, Lackfarben und Interieur und übersetzen ihre Wünsche in verbindliche Fertigungs- und Aufbereitungsaufträge.

  • Zusatzgeschäft mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Sie bieten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Sonderausstattung und Zusatzleistungen rund um Pflege und Service an, stets beratend, niemals drängend.

  • Auftragssteuerung: Sie verfolgen Termine, klären Detailfragen direkt mit Manufaktur, Werkstatt, Einkauf und Logistik und informieren den Kunden proaktiv über jeden Meilenstein. Damit sind Sie die zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren Kunden.

  • Übergabe als Höhepunkt: Sie planen und gestalten die Fahrzeugübergabe in Buchloe, beim Handelspartner oder beim Kunden, nicht als Ende des Prozesses, sondern als den ersten Höhepunkt einer langfristigen Kundenbeziehung.

  • Nachbetreuung: Sie orchestrieren nach der Übergabe in Abstimmung mit Vertrieb und Handelspartnern den laufenden Kontakt, holen Feedback ein, lösen Anliegen schnell und erkennen Anlässe für Zubehör, Service oder das nächste Fahrzeug.

  • Customer Journey weiterentwickeln: Sie werten Kundenfeedback und Zufriedenheitswerte aus, verbessern die Kontaktpunkte laufend und bringen Ideen für Kundenevents, Manufakturbesuche und Übergabeformate ein.

  • Daten, die tragen: Sie pflegen Kunden- und Auftragsdaten in CRM und ERP so, dass Vertrieb und Geschäftsleitung darauf Entscheidungen bauen.

Diese Rolle ist nicht die Sachbearbeitung hinter dem Vertrieb. Sie ist das Gesicht von Bovensiepen zwischen erster Anfrage und Schlüsselübergabe, und auch weit darüber hinaus.

Was Sie in den ersten zwölf Monaten bewegen

  • Sie lernen Kunden, Handelspartner, Manufaktur und Fahrzeuge kennen und führen die ersten Aufträge eigenverantwortlich zur Übergabe.

  • Sie zeichnen die heutige Customer Journey auf und benennen die Momente, die begeistern – und die, die wir verbessern.

  • Sie entwickeln ein Übergabe- und Nachbetreuungskonzept, das unsere Kunden so noch nicht erlebt haben und das nachhaltig in Erinnerung bleibt.

  • Sie bauen ein Angebot aus Sonderausstattung, Zusatzleistungen und Erlebnis auf, das zum Kunden passt und machen seinen Erfolg messbar.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – Gastfreundschaft und Kaufmannsverstand

Sie haben ein echtes Gespür für Menschen und Freude daran, sie zu begeistern. Sie begegnen anspruchsvollen Kunden auf Augenhöhe, sprechen mit dem Sattler über Nahtbilder und behalten zehn Aufträge parallel im Blick, ohne dass einer aus dem Raster fällt. Sie verkaufen gern, weil Sie wissen, dass das richtige Angebot zur richtigen Zeit für den Kunden ein Gewinn ist.

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Automobilkaufleute) oder Studium

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Order Management oder Vertrieb – im Premium-Automobilumfeld oder mit ähnlich anspruchsvoller Klientel, etwa bei Luxusmarken, in der Premium-Hotellerie oder im Private Banking

  • Freude am Verkaufen und nachweisbare Erfolge im Zusatz- oder Folgegeschäft

  • Begeisterung für hochwertige Fahrzeuge und den Willen, sich tief in deren Ausstattungswelt einzuarbeiten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM- (Creatio) und ERP-Systemen (z. B. Microsoft Business Central) und MS Office

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, gutes Englisch, Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen für Übergaben

Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt

  • Erfahrung mit BMW oder anderen Premium-Marken

  • Erfahrung mit Individualisierungsprogrammen, Fahrzeugkonfiguration oder Kleinserien

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenevents, Clienteling oder Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit (z. B. NPS)

  • Weitere Fremdsprache (Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Japanisch) für die Betreuung internationaler Kunden

Was uns wichtiger ist als jedes Zertifikat: der Instinkt für Menschen, der Wille, jeden Auftrag zu Ende zu denken, und die Freude daran, für einen Kunden mehr möglich zu machen, als er erwartet hat.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

Familienunternehmen seit mehr als 60 Jahren: Kurze Wege zwischen Kunde, Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung. Ihre Ideen landen nicht in einer Abstimmungsschleife, sondern bei den Menschen, die entscheiden.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Eine neue Rolle, die Sie von Beginn an prägen, mit klarer Verantwortung für das Kundenerlebnis

  • Erfolgsbeteiligung: Fixgehalt plus Bonus, gekoppelt an die Zusatzverkäufe und die Zufriedenheit Ihrer Kunden, damit Ihr Beitrag direkt sichtbar wird

  • Direkte Berichtslinie an die Vertriebsleitung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Manufaktur und Geschäftsleitung

  • Produktnähe: Fahrzeuge, die in Buchloe von Hand entstehen und leidenschaftliche Käufer, die Sie persönlich kennen und stets im Fokus halten

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb, Manufaktur und bei unseren Handelspartnern

  • Standort Buchloe im Allgäu: Hohe Lebensqualität, direkte Anbindung Richtung München, Memmingen und Augsburg

Bereit?

Wenn Sie diese Zeilen lesen und spüren, dass das für Sie mehr ist als eine Stellenanzeige, bewerben Sie sich.

jobs.title: International Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Summary

Do you enjoy connecting with new people, opening doors and turning opportunities into business? Do you get excited about exploring international markets, testing new ideas and shaping how a company grows? Are you ready to take ownership beyond traditional outbound sales?

As an International Sales Development Representative at Building Radar, you will play a key role in driving our international expansion. You'll be the first point of contact for potential customers, build high-quality sales pipeline and help shape our go-to-market strategy across new markets.

This role goes beyond traditional sales development. You'll combine hands-on outbound sales with market research, strategic experimentation and the freedom to turn your own ideas into measurable results.

If you already have some experience in SDR, BDR or go-to-market roles, enjoy taking initiative and want to make a real impact on international growth, we'd love to meet you.

Your mission

Drive International Outbound Sales: Identify high-potential companies across international markets, find key decision-makers and engage them through personalized outreach via phone, email and LinkedIn.

Build & Qualify Pipeline: Understand prospects' challenges, business goals and buying signals. Turn meaningful conversations into qualified opportunities and high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.

Shape Our Go-to-Market Strategy: Explore new markets, customer segments and outreach approaches. Test messaging, analyze results and help build scalable outbound playbooks that accelerate international growth.

Own Your Initiatives: Take responsibility for your own campaigns and market development activities. Spot opportunities, experiment with new approaches and drive your ideas from concept to measurable pipeline impact.

Create Messaging That Converts: Develop compelling outreach sequences, sales materials and personalized messaging that resonate with different industries, markets and decision-makers.

Leverage Data, AI & Sales Tools: Use CRM systems, sales automation and AI-powered tools to optimize prospecting, improve workflows and make our outbound efforts smarter and more effective.

Your profile

First SDR / GTM Experience: You already have hands-on experience in sales development, business development or a comparable go-to-market role, ideally in B2B SaaS. Experience with international prospecting, cross-border outbound or developing new markets is a strong plus.

Strong Communication Skills: You know how to engage prospects, ask the right questions and communicate value clearly. Fluent English is essential; German or another European language is a plus.

Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take initiative, identify opportunities and enjoy turning ideas into action. You're comfortable taking ownership of your work and learning from results.

Strategic Curiosity: You're interested in understanding different markets, customer needs and buying behaviors. You enjoy using data and insights to improve your approach.

Outbound Confidence: You're comfortable reaching out to new prospects, handling objections and building relationships. You understand the fundamentals of structured outbound sales and know how to create opportunities from first conversations.

Growth Mindset & Ownership: You're eager to develop your skills, open to feedback and motivated to take on increasing responsibility as our international business grows.

Why us?

Our Sales-Team:

At Building Radar, our Sales Team is at the forefront of connecting innovative technology with the people who can benefit from it. You'll engage with industry leaders, uncover their challenges and help them discover new ways to drive revenue through smarter sales processes.

As an International SDR, you won't just follow an existing playbook. You'll help improve it. You'll work closely with our Account Executives and Sales Team to explore international opportunities, exchange market insights and develop outbound approaches that deliver results. You'll have the opportunity to sharpen your sales skills while gaining hands-on experience in international go-to-market strategy, market development and sales technology.

Why Building Radar?

Shape the Revolution: Work with cutting-edge technology to drive the digital transformation of the construction industry and leave a lasting impact.

Worldwide Vibes: Join a highly motivated team of professionals from over 11 nations – we believe global diversity fuels creativity and innovation.

Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy the perfect balance of team spirit in our office and the flexibility of working from home.

Unlimited Vacation: We prioritize trust over control. Take the time you need to recharge and return with fresh ideas to tackle new challenges.

Investing in Your Future (VWL): We support your long-term wealth building with up to €40/month (for full-time, permanent employees) paid directly into a savings plan of your choice.

Financial Incentives: In addition to a fair base salary, we reward your success through variable compensation and special bonuses.

Development Budget: We invest in your growth! You receive an annual development budget of €1,000 for training, tools, and professional courses.

Cool Events: From mountain weekends and Oktoberfest visits to off-sites and go-kart racing – we believe in celebrating our success together.

Sport is our Passion: Use our in-house gym or benefit from our EGYM Wellpass subsidy (we cover over 50%) to stay fit and healthy.

You’ll Never Walk Alone: To ensure a smooth start, our Buddy Program pairs you with an experienced mentor during your onboarding.

Referral Program: Help us grow! For every successful referral of a friend or acquaintance, you can earn a bonus of up to €2,000.

jobs.title: Operation Specialist (M/W/D)
jobs.description:
Über SR Travel

Die SR Travel GmbH & Co. KG in Gießen ist ein internationaler Reiseveranstalter für Gruppenreisen, Lieferant für touristische Direktvertriebe sowie Incoming-Agentur für D & EU. Inspirierende Reisen mit echten Erlebnissen sind unser Spezialgebiet, und wir konzipieren sowie organisieren Groß- und Kleinserien, MICE-Projekte sowie maßgeschneiderte Gruppenreisen mit einem internationalen Netzwerk aus Hotels, DMCs, Beförderungsunternehmen und weiteren touristischen Leistungspartnern.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen sorgfältigen und zahlenaffinen Operations Specialist, der die operative Vorbereitung und Abwicklung unserer Gruppen- und Serienreisen unterstützt, reisebezogene Daten zuverlässig pflegt und zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und Systeme beiträgt.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Operative Reiseabwicklung und Saisonvorbereitung: Sie übernehmen die operative Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung von Gruppen- und Serienreisen im Backoffice. Vor Saisonbeginn schaffen Sie die erforderlichen Strukturen und Datengrundlagen für eine reibungslose Reiseabwicklung.

  • Touren- und Systempflege: Sie legen einzelne Touren in unseren unternehmensspezifischen Systemen an und aktualisieren die relevanten reisebezogenen Daten während der laufenden Saison.

  • Kontingent- und Leistungspflege: Sie prüfen und pflegen Kontingente, nehmen Hotelzuteilungen vor und legen Hotels, Nebenleistungsgeber sowie weitere touristische Leistungspartner in den eingesetzten Systemen an.

  • Buchungs- und Teilnehmerdaten: Sie übertragen und pflegen Buchungsnummern, Gäste- und Teilnehmerzahlen sowie weitere für die Reiseabwicklung erforderliche Informationen. Dabei kontrollieren Sie die Daten auf Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität.

  • Reiseunterlagen und Dokumentenmanagement: Sie erstellen, prüfen und versenden Teilnehmerlisten, Voucher und weitere Reiseunterlagen fristgerecht. Damit stellen Sie eine vollständige und korrekte Dokumentation entlang des gesamten Reiseverlaufs sicher.

  • Listen und Datenauswertungen: Sie erstellen und pflegen operative Arbeitslisten in MS Excel beziehungsweise LibreOffice Calc. Umfangreiche Tabellen, Datenbestände, Formeln und Auswertungslogiken prüfen Sie sorgfältig auf Funktionalität und Richtigkeit.

  • Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Sie bearbeiten kurzfristige Änderungen und übertragen diese zuverlässig in die relevanten Systeme, Listen und Reiseunterlagen. Offene operative Themen verfolgen Sie nach und koordinieren die notwendigen Maßnahmen mit den beteiligten Stellen.

  • Klärungs- und Beschwerdefälle: Sie unterstützen bei der Bearbeitung operativer Klärungs- und Beschwerdefälle. Hierfür recherchieren und analysieren Sie Sachverhalte, identifizieren mögliche Fehlerquellen und wirken an geeigneten Lösungen mit.

  • Prozess- und Tooloptimierung: Sie überprüfen bestehende Arbeitsabläufe, Datenstrukturen und eingesetzte Tools und zeigen Verbesserungspotenziale auf. Vorhandene Formeln und Auswertungslogiken in Excel beziehungsweise LibreOffice Calc passen Sie bei Bedarf an und entwickeln diese weiter.

  • Import- und Datenübernahmeprozesse: Sie unterstützen bei der Anwendung, Prüfung und Weiterentwicklung von Importern. Bei Bedarf arbeiten Sie an der Optimierung bestehender oder an der Entwicklung neuer Import- und Datenübernahmeprozesse mit.

  • Digitale und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen: Sie bringen Ihr Interesse an digitalen Lösungen ein und unterstützen – soweit für das Aufgabengebiet sinnvoll – die Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung KI-gestützter Prozesse und Systeme.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Sie arbeiten eng mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen und Abteilungen zusammen. Bei operativen, systemseitigen und prozessbezogenen Fragestellungen unterstützen Sie die beteiligten Teams und wirken an abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten mit.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder touristische Ausbildung, abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der kaufmännischen Sachbearbeitung; Erfahrung im Backoffice ist von Vorteil

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel; Kenntnisse in LibreOffice Calc sind von Vorteil

  • Sicherer Umgang mit umfangreichen Tabellen, Datenlisten, komplexen Formeln und Auswertungslogiken

  • Ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität sowie ein gutes Verständnis für große Datenmengen, Zusammenhänge und Plausibilitäten

  • Erfahrung mit datenbasierten Prozessen, Importen oder systemgestützter Datenpflege ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in Optimierungsprojekten oder bei der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Arbeitsabläufen ist wünschenswert

  • Affinität zu digitalen Tools sowie Interesse an der praktischen Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung KI-gestützter Arbeitsweisen

  • Sehr sorgfältige, genaue und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

In Ihren ersten Monaten übernehmen Sie die operative Betreuung laufender Gruppenreisen und arbeiten sich in unsere bestehenden Buchungs- und Abstimmungsprozesse mit unseren internationalen Partnern ein. Sie lernen unser Netzwerk aus Hotels und Dienstleistern kennen und steuern die ersten eigenen Projekte von der Vorbereitung bis zur finalen Abwicklung. Sollten Sie nicht alle Anforderungen zu hundert Prozent erfüllen, freuen wir uns dennoch auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir Ihnen

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position als Operations Specialist Gruppen- und Serienreisen bei einem international tätigen B2B-Reiseveranstalter

  • Ein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet in der operativen Vorbereitung und Abwicklung internationaler Reiseprogramme

  • Die Möglichkeit, bestehende Arbeitsabläufe, Datenstrukturen und digitale Tools aktiv weiterzuentwickeln

  • Mitarbeit an abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten sowie an der Einführung moderner und KI-gestützter Arbeitsweisen

  • Direkte Entscheidungswege und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und ein serviceorientiertes Team

jobs.title: Head of Marketing (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
80% of the world's workforce doesn't sit at a desk. Ordio 💙 is the all-in-one platform that helps these teams run their day: shift planning, time tracking, absence & document management. Simple, fast, and human.

We're at an exciting stage of growth: around €5m ARR, with strong foundations in DACH, new products in market, and international expansion underway. Marketing now has the opportunity to become a major growth lever for the business connecting brand, demand generation, product and sales into one commercial engine.

We’re looking for a senior, commercially minded marketing leader to build and scale Ordio’s marketing engine for the next stage of growth.

You’ll own Marketing end to end, with clear accountability for pipeline, new ARR and efficient growth. You’ll work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product to sharpen our positioning, scale acquisition, improve conversion, and expand a successful GTM motion into new European markets.

The opportunity is to build the next version of Ordio’s marketing organisation and grow with the company toward a true CMO level role as Ordio scales toward €20–50m ARR.

Tasks

  • Own Ordio’s marketing strategy, budget and operating cadence, with a clear focus on pipeline, customers, ARR, CAC and payback.
  • Build and scale a measurable demand generation engine across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, organic, content and SEO.
  • Go deep into campaign performance, creative, landing pages and conversion — not just manage agencies or dashboards.
  • Own the full funnel from first touch through Closed Won, including lifecycle, CRM, nurture and conversion optimisation.
  • Sharpen Ordio’s positioning and messaging, translating an increasingly broad product suite into simple, differentiated customer value.
  • Raise the bar on brand and creative quality while maintaining strong commercial accountability.
  • Work closely with Sales on shared pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Partner with Product on launches, self-service, trials, PLG experiments and conversion loops.
  • Build the right team, processes, reporting and agency/freelancer setup as the function grows.
  • Help internationalise Ordio’s acquisition engine and establish repeatable GTM playbooks for new European markets.

Requirements

  • Significant in house experience in B2B SaaS / software.
  • Experience scaling a SaaS company through a comparable growth stage, ideally somewhere between €3–10m ARR and €15–30m+ ARR.
  • Strong experience with high-volume SMB / Lower Mid-Market acquisition, rather than only enterprise ABM.
  • A proven ability to generate measurable pipeline, customers and revenue through marketing.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Google, Meta and LinkedIn, ideally having owned meaningful budgets of €100k+ per month.
  • Strong command of CAC, CPL, conversion, payback, pipeline economics and ARR.
  • A full-funnel mindset: you think from acquisition through Closed Won, not just MQL generation.
  • Strong understanding of brand, positioning, messaging and creative quality alongside performance marketing.
  • Good understanding of content, SEO, lifecycle, CRM and conversion optimisation.
  • Experience working closely with Sales on shared revenue targets and Product on launches, PLG and positioning.
  • Experience leading and developing a marketing team while remaining willing to go deep into campaigns, numbers and execution.
  • A genuine builder mentality: you’ve built or materially improved teams, processes, reporting and acquisition engines.
  • Fluent German and business-fluent English.

Benefits

💰 Competitive compensation & benefits

🚀 True ownership of a core growth function with direct impact on pipeline and ARR

🧠 A steep learning curve across growth, product, international expansion and company building

💻 Top-tier equipment (MacBook Pro M4 or higher)

🏡 Flexible setup: Hybrid or fully remote within Germany

💪 Well-being support: Subsidized gym memberships, wellness initiatives, Jobrad

🌎 Guided by our values: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, Earth Is

At Ordio 💙, we're looking for people who want to be more than just another employee: ambitious, forward-thinking, and ready to shape the future of work.

If you want to build the marketing engine behind Ordio’s next stage of growth, work closely with the CEO, Sales and Product, and have real ownership over how we scale across Europe, we'd love to hear from you..

Ordio is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Architects - Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Munich, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's Digital Native customers across the DACH region. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Munich or Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship.

  • Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture across Europe, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market.

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements.

  • Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

  • Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.

  • Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

  • Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth.

  • Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices.

  • Foster a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, and effective specialist handoffs.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment.

  • Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises.

  • Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams.

  • Have guided enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact.

  • Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers.

  • Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements.

  • Exercise strong architectural judgment, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems.

  • Are comfortable leading across DACH and partnering across European markets from Munich, adapting your approach to different industries, cultures, regulatory contexts, and customer operating models.

  • Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership.

  • Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Intern Strategic Projects (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest strategische Projekte im Bereich Baubarkeit von der ersten Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Du analysierst unseren Sales- und Operations-Funnel und identifizierst, an welchen Stellen und aus welchen Gründen wir bei Kund:innen nicht bauen können.

  • Du bewertest den Impact unterschiedlicher Initiativen, erstellst Business Cases und leitest daraus Prioritäten ab.

  • Du identifizierst innovative Bautechnologien und Prozesse im Bereich erneuerbarer Energien und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team in die Umsetzung.

  • Du steuerst die Realisierung mit Operations, Technik, Software und externen Partnern, bis die Lösung im Tagesgeschäft funktioniert.

  • Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle von Prozessen, technischen Fragestellungen und Softwarethemen und bringst die richtigen Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Du bist Teil eines kleinen, agilen Teams, übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und siehst unmittelbar, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst, befindest dich im Gap Year oder hast dein Studium kürzlich abgeschlossen, wobei die Fachrichtung zweitrangig ist.

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in einem Startup oder Scale-up, einer Beratung oder im Banking.

  • Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, auch wenn sie technisch werden.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kommunizierst klar und überzeugend mit Stakeholdern aus unterschiedlichsten Bereichen.

  • Du möchtest nah am Geschehen sein und echten Impact haben und hast Lust, 3 bis 6 Monate mit dem Team vor Ort in Berlin zu arbeiten.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

The position explicitly focuses on strategic business partnership rather than operational HR activities.

  • Shape and scale a high-performing global R&D organization by designing structures, operating models, leadership layers, and talent strategies that support rapid growth and increasing organizational complexity.

  • Lead the people-related aspects of mergers, acquisitions, and organizational integrations, ensuring successful onboarding of acquired teams, leadership alignment, cultural integration, and talent retention.

  • Partner with executive stakeholders to anticipate future capability requirements and develop workforce strategies that secure critical engineering and technology talent.

jobs.title: Bid Manager UK (all genders)
jobs.company_name: ubitricity - Gesellschaft für verteilte Energiesysteme mbH
jobs.description:
Your Mission

About the Role
We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Bid Manager to lead and project manage the end-to-end tender and proposal process across our UK business.
You will take ownership of each bid from early qualification and planning through to submission, clarification, handover and post-bid review. This includes setting the bid strategy, defining responsibilities, coordinating contributors, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring that decisions and deliverables are completed to the required quality and deadline.
The role requires someone who can bring structure and momentum to complex tender processes, engage stakeholders across different functions and levels, and constructively challenge assumptions, contributions and proposed solutions. Working closely with Commercial, Operations, Delivery, Product, Legal, Finance and central teams, you will ensure that submissions are compliant, compelling, deliverable and commercially robust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full bid lifecycle from opportunity qualification and bid planning through to submission, clarification, contract handover and post-bid review.
  • Develop and maintain clear bid plans covering deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, review stages, approvals, resources and deadlines.
  • Lead bid kick-offs, progress reviews, solution workshops and final submission reviews, creating clarity and accountability across all contributors.
  • Coordinate and actively manage internal stakeholders, external consultants and specialist partners, challenging delays, unclear ownership or insufficient contributions.
  • Identify bid risks, dependencies, gaps and decision requirements early, escalating where necessary to protect quality, commercial viability and timelines.
  • Lead bid qualification and go/no-go assessments, ensuring that client requirements and commercial, technical, operational and delivery implications are fully understood.
  • Develop the bid strategy, win themes, key messages and overall proposal structure in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure that submissions are compliant, persuasive, commercially competitive and operationally deliverable, constructively challenging assumptions and proposed commitments.
  • Own the overall quality and consistency of proposal content, turning cross-functional input into one clear, client-focused response.
  • Maintain an accurate tender pipeline and clear reporting on opportunity status, key dates, resource requirements, risks and decisions.
  • Improve bid-management tools, governance and reusable content, including Jira-based planning and appropriate use of AI-supported bidding solutions.
  • Ensure a structured handover of successful bids, including commitments, assumptions, risks, dependencies, SLAs and implementation obligations, to Delivery and Operations.

Your profile

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading complex bids, proposals or tender processes from qualification through to submission and handover.
  • Strong project-management skills, including planning, stakeholder coordination, risk management, governance and action tracking.
  • Confidence coordinating and constructively challenging contributors across different functions and levels of seniority.
  • Ability to create accountability and maintain momentum without relying on formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex input into clear and persuasive proposals.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to understand client priorities, operational constraints and business risks.
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies and unrealistic commitments early and drive timely decisions.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing several concurrent deadlines and changing priorities.
  • Experience with public-sector procurement, framework agreements or infrastructure tenders would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience in EV charging, energy, transport, mobility, utilities or related infrastructure, and familiarity with Jira, CRM or proposal-management tools, would be beneficial.

Our Offer

Location & Ways of Working

Location
ubitricity Distributed Energy Systems UK Ltd.

We operate a hybrid working model and believe that collaboration is at its best when people spend time together. jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.


For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The Scope

  • Onboarding & offboarding: sign-up, trials, tenant and workspace provisioning, and the first-run experience. Getting a new firm from contract to value, fast.

  • Metering & billing: real-time usage and credit consumption for our agentic products, through to invoicing, payments and revenue reporting.

What You Will Do

  • Lead through outcomes, not tasks. Set clear goals and trust the team to find the how.

  • Make the team measurably better. Raise the bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance directly.

  • Own the technical direction of the full customer lifecycle platform, and stay close enough to the code to make the hard calls credibly.

  • Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: accurate metering, enforced entitlements, reliable billing, all observable, secure and auditable.

  • Treat onboarding as a product. Measure activation and time-to-value, and remove friction with Product and Design.

  • Continuously improve on the admin experience to delight and empower our internal users.

  • Turn commercial strategy into software. Partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to shape pricing, packaging and licensing models.

  • Set the bar for AI-assisted engineering. Not just shipping faster, but taking on harder problems, and shaping how DataSnipper engineering uses AI.

  • Grow the scope. Expand ownership and stand up new teams as the area grows.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, on top of 5+ years as a software engineer

  • An empowerment style of leadership and a track record of building high-performing teams

  • Experience building billing, licensing, entitlement or onboarding systems at scale, ideally usage- or credit-based

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native development

  • Experience running production systems where financial correctness matters

  • Strong product aptitude: you challenge framing, make roadmap trade-offs, and care about activation and conversion as much as uptime

  • Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools and agentic harnesses, and a team that is measurably better for using them

  • A strategic, entrepreneurial mindset: you shape direction, not just execute it

Nice to Have

  • Usage-, metered- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution

  • Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe), CRM and ERP integrations

  • Identity and provisioning: SSO, SCIM, multi-tenant account models

  • Product-led growth: self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades

  • Python, Azure and observability tooling

What We Offer

Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.
Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way.
 
Founded in Paris in 2009, Vestiaire Collective is now a globally scaled marketplace with offices in Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, and logistics hubs across Europe, Asia, and the US.
Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry.
 
Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

About the role : 

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will play a key role in our data ecosystem by modelling raw datasets into clear, reliable, and scalable data products that power strategic decision-making across the business.

Embedded within the central Analytics Engineering team, you will own and evolve data pipelines and analytical data products that support teams across Product, Marketing, CRM, Finance, Operations, and other areas of the business.

Beyond core development, you will drive data reliability, elevate our technical standards, and experiment with AI-assisted tools to streamline modern data workflows.

• Strong SQL and data transformation skills(DBT), including complex transformations and modular, reusable data models.

• Experience with version controlling (GitHub), CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and observability.

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

 

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

 

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

 

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Overview

As a Sales Director EMEA you will be part of the leadership team, reporting directly to the CRO. You will be leading a team of Account Executives. Now that the company has a repeatable sales motion, your task will be to build a well-oiled revenue engine. You will drive ARR growth by hiring and developing sales talents, lead expansion in new geographies and segments, and set an upmarket trajectory to increase ACV.


The position is based in Paris and frequent travel is to be expected.

  • Work with your team to identify, nurture and execute on key opportunities to drive high value deals, serve as an Executive Sponsor for critical customer and prospect relationships

  • Build, mentor, and lead our sales team to exceed targets. Implement effective recruitment strategies to assemble a top-tier sales force

  • Oversee the creation of training programs, sales materials, and a comprehensive onboarding process. Own SalesOps, including revenue forecasting and tooling

  • Develop and maintain a strong network of customers, partners, and industry thought-leaders

  • Implement and operate the outbound acquisition machine ;

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with with Marketing, Product and Solution Consultants to address new market segments

  • Be an ambassador for the company, participate in industry events and represent Dotfile

About you

  • Over three years of sales leadership experience in Enterprise SaaS or Fintech, ideally in the compliance and fraud sectors, utilizing a proven sales playbook (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and consistently exceeding quota and revenue goals.

  • Experience within the Financial Services industry

  • Prior success selling into large, complex environments with multiple decision makers

  • Proven track record of helping VC-backed startups go from $1M ARR to $10M ARR

  • Strong technical acumen and project management skills coupled with a data-driven mindset

  • Successful experience building, managing and retaining high performing teams across multiple markets

  • A proven ability to build connections with industry subject matter experts and customer executives

  • Outstanding communication skills, high energy and deep empathy

  • Willingness to embark on the startup journey, get your hands dirty and close deals yourself

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • CEO and Board exposition

  • Ability to work from our Paris Office
